decisions.reason: ACE3 is a flagship distributed ALCMS control platform launched in 2018 and promoted as a new industry standard, and airfield lighting control products have long lifecycles with strong installed-base lock-in, so withdrawing it within a year is very unlikely.

Air situation displays for surveillance are long-cycle, certification-heavy products tied to multi-year airport and ATC contracts, so the firm will keep supporting and selling it despite less prominent marketing.
